'''Mere Tugs''' were a type of [[Spacetug/Legends|tug]] used by the [[Mere]] in the time shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
A Mere Tug had two [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for propulsion and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] for intersellar travel. The tug moved material around using [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]].

==History==
The [[Mere Resistance]] [[Mere cruiser|cruiser]] ''[[Tritus]]'' launched four Mere Tugs in the later parts in a [[Battle of Nod Kartha|conflict]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nod Kartha]] to recover four parts to an [[Orbital Defense Cannon]]. The tugs were able to bring the parts back to the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] despite the efforts of [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]] to collect the components for their own means. The ''Tritus'' suffered an engine failure on the way to delivering the cannon parts to [[Khons]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] where the cannon would be installed, so the Mere Tugs had to take them the rest of the journey. The tugs set up the cannon on Khons, where it would be used in the [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|liberation]] of Lok from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==Behind the scenes==
These tugs appear in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]'' during the game's tenth mission, "Tug of War." The player's objective is to escort the four tugs while they recover the cannon pieces. If any is lost, it will just be replaced by another.
